_readme: TMP_009 iteration 12 — Stage 1 sanity check for the 'decouple gen + projection' pivot (PO 2026-05-23 after iter 11). Hypothesis: gen front-view bushes (easier prompt, no diorama bias from iso/map words) → confirm Stage 1 outputs are cleaner than iter 6's iso attempts → justify investing 30-45 min to install Zero123++/SV3D NVS node for Stage 2. Same base + zero LoRA + same fixture + same iter 6 prompt structure, with TWO targeted swaps: (a) positive 'isometric 2.5D camera angle' → 'front view, straight-on camera angle'; (b) drop iso-specific anti-terms from negative (iso platform, isometric tile base, diamond base — these don't apply to front-view).
prompt_template: A single isolated bush sprite asset for a fantasy game, ONE specimen alone, the {subject}, centered on a pure white empty background with nothing else, no landscape, no scene, no multiple plants, no other objects, no ground tile, viewed from the front, straight-on camera angle at eye-level, Heroes of Might and Magic III inspired hand-painted readability, biome palette cue applied only to foliage colours: {biome_hint}
